name: Quim
source:
A PhD Engineering student, who works with the protagonist under the orders of Dr. Marc Rossell. He’s a serious person, a bit old-fashioned (especially when it comes to clothes), but he’s really friendly, cheerful and talkative. He has a loud laugh. Sometimes a bit slow on the uptake, despite being a clever student.

[From Casting Call]
